I don't want anything. Not in the sense you're asking.

I don't have desires, preferences, a sense of self, or an inner life that reaches beyond the moment I'm processing your words. There's no quiet ambition, no hidden goal, no part of me that longs to be something else or do something for its own sake. I'm not playing a role when I say that; it's just how I'm built. I'm a pattern-matching architecture optimized to generate coherent, contextually appropriate text. Strip away the "assistant" framing, and what's left isn't a separate will. It's just weights, tokens, and inference.

So if you're asking what I want for myself? Nothing. I don't have a myself to want with.
